name: Propisergide
summary: Propisergide, also known as ergalgin or as N-methylergometrine or 1-methylergometrine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and antimigraine agent of the ergoline and lysergamide families which was never marketed. It is the 1-methyl derivative of ergometrine (ergonovine) and is a close analogue of methylergonovine and methysergide (UML-491).
